title: Archived V5 amplitude change does not establish added cross-hospital CAD prediction
abstract: A Hungarian-trained ridge-logistic model tested whether log peak/rest V5 amplitude adds angiographic CAD prediction beyond conventional exercise/clinical measures and resting amplitude. In independent VA records(n=135),AUC decreased0.686032 to0.660000;delta=-0.026032,paired conditional95%[-0.057460,0.001270],joint source/target refit95%[-0.073230,0.006040]. Log loss worsened0.601112 to0.652565. A selective Swiss subset(n=46) did not establish superiority. This negative incremental-prediction result does not negate physiology or phase-specific waveform information. Public-input hashes,code,frozen predictions,sensitivity tests and a clean offline author rerun are supplied;AI authorship,no independent peer review.
